facts.fact: TechCentral reports that the Campaign for Free Expression made a request to Meta on 3 April 2024 under South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act (Paia), described as a South African law.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act (Paia)

facts.fact: TechCentral reports that the Information Regulator received the CFE's complaint over Meta's refusal of its Paia request and acknowledged that an inquiry into Meta is under way, with no decision stated.

systems.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act (Paia)
